overall_assessment: Where the page holds a real plan, extraction is complete and clean (all sections, facts box, no navigation). Two institution-wide problems remain: many offerings get the latest published plan under a 'not published yet' notice (wrong year), and some course codes return the course-search listing instead of a plan (wrong page).

findings.evidence:
Emnesøket gjelder kun fra 2022. Før dette må emnene finnes i studieplanen
1FA11-1 Helsefremmende fysisk aktivitet 1
findings.description: For these course codes the extracted text is the catalogue's course-search listing (hundreds of 'code title' lines of other courses, some duplicated), not the plan for this course. The 30k-character texts contain no plan sections at all; the only page text not captured is the 'Studiearkiv' year picker. 31 offerings share this dup_code pattern (three codes shown in the sample: 1AKT01, 2PRLU20-29, and the 2PRLU20-29 autumn offering).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The studiekatalog URL for these codes/years (e.g. /emne/1AKT01/2023-host) returns the search/listing page, not a course page; selector .content-inner matches the listing container. No check rejects a page lacking the plan headings.
findings.suggested_fix: In R/institution_config.R inn post/validation step: treat a page whose text starts with 'Emnesøket gjelder kun fra 2022' (or lacks 'Emnets innhold'/'Course content' and 'Læringsutbytte'/'Learning outcome') as a failed fetch (empty text, flagged), and check whether the code needs a different URL form (e.g. with the '-1' version suffix or different code case).

findings.evidence: Emnebeskrivelsen for valgt semester er ikke publisert enda. Her er den siste versjonen vi har tilgjengelig.
findings.description: The site silently serves the latest available plan when none is published for the requested semester. The text then describes a different year (e.g. 2023 spring offering shows 'Startsemestre 2026 Høst ... Undervisningssemestre 2026 Høst'; KDBA950 autumn 2023 shows 2027 Vår), so downstream analysis would attribute a 2025/2026 plan to 2023. Almost all suspects and several random controls (3RIS100 2025 spring, UTM1151, KDBA950) are affected.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: plan_years = url builds /emne/CODE/YYYY-semester URLs; the site falls back to the newest version with a 'Statusmelding' banner instead of returning 404.
findings.suggested_fix: Detect the 'Statusmelding' fallback text ('ikke publisert enda' / 'Kun tilgjengelig på engelsk' is a separate language notice) and mark the offering plan_year_mismatch/NA, or drop it from the year-specific frame; at minimum record the fallback flag and the 'Undervisningssemestre' year in a column so analysts can filter.

Statusmelding
Emnebeskrivelsen for valgt semester er ikke publisert enda. Her er den siste versjonen vi har tilgjengelig.
findings.description: Every text begins with the page's status banner ('Statusmelding' plus a sentence, or 'Kun tilgjengelig på engelsk'), and the 'Startsemestre' year list and the repeated course code/title header precede the plan. These are page chrome, not plan text.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Selector .content-inner includes the banner and header block; no exclude for it in the inn config.
findings.suggested_fix: Add exclude for the Statusmelding block (and its heading) in the inn entry of R/institution_config.R, after recording the fallback flag for the wrong_year finding.

findings.description: Table cells are tab-separated, but the metadata facts box and fields come as alternating label/value lines ('Studiepoeng' / '7,5'), and the exam table rows have missing cells without placeholder (e.g. 'Ingen' with no proportion). Minor structure loss; some words are glued ('ofdifference').
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: html_text on label/value blocks without a table-aware serializer.
findings.suggested_fix: Low priority; optionally emit 'label: value' for the facts box in the inn post_fn.
